</script><style id="pcta-css">
/* ===== Base: isolate the widget from theme/framework styles ===== */
#pcta-root{
  --pcta-font:"Bitly Display","Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --pcta-navy:#031F39;--pcta-orange:#F36600;--pcta-cream:#FFFDF8;--pcta-sand:#F7F4EE;
  --pcta-stone:#D6D2C9;--pcta-blue:#0058DD;--pcta-red:#C32813;
  --pcta-z:1000;
  font:400 16px/1.4 var(--pcta-font);color:var(--pcta-navy);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity 600ms;
}
#pcta-root.pcta-loaded{opacity:1}
#pcta-root,#pcta-root *,#pcta-root *::before,#pcta-root *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
#pcta-root :where(div,ul,li,h5,p,a,span,label,form,input,button,img){
  margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;float:none;
  font:inherit;color:inherit;letter-spacing:normal;text-transform:none;text-decoration:none;
  text-shadow:none;list-style:none;min-height:0;max-width:none;outline-offset:2px;
}
#pcta-root :where(input,button){-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;border-radius:0}
#pcta-root svg{display:block;overflow:visible}
@media all and (max-height:515px){#pcta-root{display:none!important}}

/* ===== Front page: reveal after scrolling ===== */
#pcta-root.pcta-scroll-reveal .pctacontent{opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
#pcta-root.pcta-scroll-reveal.pcta-hooked .pctacontent{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}

/* ===== Shell ===== */
#pcta-root .pctacontent{
  position:fixed;bottom:10px;right:12px;overflow:hidden;z-index:var(--pcta-z);
  border-radius:15px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgba(3,31,57,.35),0 2px 10px 2px rgba(3,31,57,.25);
}

/* ===== Collapsed banner ===== */
#pcta-root .pctabanner{
  padding:8px 8px 8px 16px;background-color:var(--pcta-orange);
  border:1px solid var(--pcta-navy);border-radius:16px;
  max-height:60px;transition:all 400ms;
}
#pcta-root .pcta-expanded .pctabanner{
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;visibility:hidden;position:absolute;max-height:1px;overflow:hidden;
}
#pcta-root .pctabanner-inner{display:flex;flex-direction:row;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
#pcta-root .pctabanner-inner .banner-item+.banner-item{margin-left:8px}
#pcta-root .pctabanner-inner .banner-item.action-link{margin-left:20px}
#pcta-root .pcta-logomark,#pcta-root .pcta-logomark svg{display:block;width:24px;height:24px}
#pcta-root .pctabanner-inner h5{
  font-family:var(--pcta-font);font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;
  color:var(--pcta-navy);white-space:nowrap;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0;
}
#pcta-root .pcta-action{
  display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;
  width:48px;padding:0 12px 0 0;
  background-color:var(--pcta-cream);border-radius:10px;
  font-family:var(--pcta-font);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;
  color:var(--pcta-navy);cursor:pointer;transition:all 300ms;
}
#pcta-root .pcta-action svg{min-width:48px}
#pcta-root .pcta-action span{display:inline-block;opacity:0;white-space:nowrap;transition:all 300ms}
#pcta-root .pcta-action:hover,#pcta-root .pcta-action:focus-visible{
  background-color:var(--pcta-navy);color:var(--pcta-cream);width:140px;
}
#pcta-root .pcta-action:hover span,#pcta-root .pcta-action:focus-visible span{opacity:1}

/* ===== Expanded panel ===== */
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs-container{
  opacity:0;height:0;overflow:hidden;
  background-color:var(--pcta-cream);border-radius:16px;transition:all 600ms;
}
#pcta-root .pcta-expanded .pcta-tabs-container{opacity:1;height:360px;width:318px}
#pcta-root .pcta-expanded.pcta-tab-qr .pcta-tabs-container{height:493px}

/* Tab bar */
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:6px 8px 6px 16px;margin:0;background-color:var(--pcta-cream);
}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li{padding:0;cursor:pointer}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tabs-logo{cursor:auto}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tabs-logo span,#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tabs-logo svg{display:block;width:64px;height:56px}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tab{margin-right:-17px}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tab+li.pcta-tab{margin-right:0;margin-left:-15px}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs a{display:block;padding:0;border-radius:4px;color:var(--pcta-navy);cursor:pointer}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tab a{height:58px}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li svg{border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tabs-logo svg{cursor:auto}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tab svg:hover,#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tabs-close svg:hover{background-color:var(--pcta-stone)}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tab:hover a{background-color:var(--pcta-stone);color:var(--pcta-navy)}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs li.pcta-tab.pcta-is-active a{background-color:#D6E7FF;color:var(--pcta-blue)}
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs-close button{display:block;width:24px;height:24px;color:#000;cursor:pointer;line-height:0}

/* Panels */
#pcta-root .pcta-tabs-content{
  background-color:var(--pcta-sand);border-top:1px solid var(--pcta-stone);border-radius:16px;
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px 0 rgba(146,144,138,.25);
}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel{display:none;padding:0}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel.pcta-is-active{display:block}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel h5{
  font-family:var(--pcta-font);font-size:24px;font-weight:600;line-height:22px;
  color:var(--pcta-navy);margin:0 0 30px;padding:26px 16px 6px;
}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel label{
  display:block;padding:0 16px;margin:0 0 73px;
  font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--pcta-navy);transition:all 300ms;cursor:default;
}
#pcta-root #pcta-qr label{margin-bottom:15px}
#pcta-root #pcta-qr.invalid label{margin-bottom:45px}

/* QR preview */
#pcta-root .pcta-panel p{text-align:center;margin:-10px 0 24px;color:#0A0A0A;transition:all 300ms}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel .invalid p{opacity:.5;margin:-10px 0 12px}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel p img{display:block;width:160px;height:160px;margin:0 auto}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel p span{
  display:block;height:18px;overflow:hidden;opacity:1;
  color:#6C6965;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:18px;transition:all 300ms;
}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel .invalid p span{opacity:0;height:0}

/* URL field */
#pcta-root .pcta-panel input[type="url"]{
  display:block;width:100%;height:auto;margin:4px 0 0;padding:8px 16px;
  font-family:var(--pcta-font);font-size:16px;line-height:24px;color:var(--pcta-navy);
  background-color:var(--pcta-cream);border:1px solid #777570;border-radius:8px;
  box-shadow:none;outline:none;
  transition:box-shadow .5s,border-color .25s ease-in-out;
}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel input[type="url"]:hover{background-color:var(--pcta-sand);border-color:#6C6965}
#pcta-root .pcta-panel input[type="url"]:focus{background-color:var(--pcta-cream);border-color:var(--pcta-blue);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--pcta-blue)}

<script id="pcta-js">
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function init() {
    var root = document.getElementById('pcta-root');
    if (!root || root.getAttribute('data-pcta-ready')) return;
    root.setAttribute('data-pcta-ready', '1');

    var box = root.querySelector('.pctacontent');
    var panelWrap = root.querySelector('.pcta-tabs-container');
    var openers = root.querySelectorAll('[data-pcta-open]');
    var tabLinks = root.querySelectorAll('[data-pcta-tab]');
    var errorText = root.getAttribute('data-error') || 'Enter a valid URL';

    /* ---- URL validation (same rules as the original widget) ---- */
    var WITH_PROTOCOL = /^(https?:\/\/(www\.)?|ftp:\/\/(www\.)?|www\.)[0-9A-Za-z\-.@:%_+~#=]+(\.[a-zA-Z]{2,3})+(\/.*)?(\?.*)?/;
    var WITHOUT_PROTOCOL = /^[0-9A-Za-z\-.@:%_+~#=]+(\.[a-zA-Z]{2,3})+(\/.*)?(\?.*)?/;
    function isUrlValid(url) {
      return WITH_PROTOCOL.test(url) || WITHOUT_PROTOCOL.test(url);
    }

    /* ---- Open / close ---- */
    function setExpanded(open) {
      box.classList.toggle('pcta-expanded', open);
      panelWrap.inert = !open;
      for (var i = 0; i < openers.length; i++) openers[i].setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    }

    /* ---- Tabs ---- */
    function selectTab(name, focusTab) {
      for (var i = 0; i < tabLinks.length; i++) {
        var link = tabLinks[i];
        var active = link.getAttribute('data-pcta-tab') === name;
        var panel = document.getElementById(link.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
        link.parentNode.classList.toggle('pcta-is-active', active);
        link.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
        link.setAttribute('tabindex', active ? '0' : '-1');
        if (panel) panel.classList.toggle('pcta-is-active', active);
        if (active && focusTab) link.focus();
      }
      box.classList.toggle('pcta-tab-qr', name === 'qr');
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < openers.length; i++) {
      openers[i].addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        selectTab(this.getAttribute('data-pcta-open'));
        setExpanded(true);
      });
    }

    for (var j = 0; j < tabLinks.length; j++) {
      tabLinks[j].addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        selectTab(this.getAttribute('data-pcta-tab'));
      });
      tabLinks[j].addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
          e.preventDefault();
          selectTab(this.getAttribute('data-pcta-tab') === 'link' ? 'qr' : 'link', true);
        }
      });
    }

    root.querySelector('[data-pcta-close]').addEventListener('click', function () {
      setExpanded(false);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && box.classList.contains('pcta-expanded')) setExpanded(false);
    });

    /* ---- Forms ---- */
    function validate(form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('.pcta-hook-url');
      var error = form.querySelector('.errormessage');
      var button = form.querySelector('.pcta-btn');
      var url = input.value.trim();
      var valid = url !== '' && isUrlValid(url);

      input.classList.toggle('error', url !== '' && !valid);
      input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', url !== '' && !valid ? 'true' : 'false');
      form.classList.toggle('invalid', !valid);
      error.textContent = url !== '' && !valid ? errorText : '';
      button.disabled = !valid;
      return valid ? url : null;
    }

    function submit(form) {
      var url = validate(form);
      if (!url) {
        form.querySelector('.pcta-hook-url').focus();
        return;
      }
      var rd = form.querySelector('input[name="rd"]');
      var hookType = form.querySelector('.hook-type').value;
      var base = rd.getAttribute('data-base') || rd.value;
      rd.setAttribute('data-base', base); // keeps the original value if the visitor comes back
      rd.value = base +
        '?hook_url=' + encodeURIComponent(url) +
        '&hook_backhalf=null' +
        '&hook_type=' + encodeURIComponent(hookType) +
        '&free_hook=true';
      form.submit();
    }

    var forms = root.querySelectorAll('.pcta-form');
    for (var k = 0; k < forms.length; k++) {
      (function (form) {
        form.querySelector('.pcta-hook-url').addEventListener('input', function () { validate(form); });
        form.querySelector('.pcta-btn').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          submit(form);
        });
        form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) { // Enter key
          e.preventDefault();
          submit(form);
        });
      })(forms[k]);
    }

    /* ---- Front page: show after scrolling past the hero ---- */
    if (root.classList.contains('pcta-scroll-reveal')) {
      var onScroll = function () {
        var offset = window.innerWidth > 1023 ? 630 : 530;
        var hooked = (window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop) >= offset;
        root.classList.toggle('pcta-hooked', hooked);
        document.body.classList.toggle('is-hooked', hooked); // kept for anything still keyed to the old class
      };
      window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
      onScroll();
    }

    setExpanded(false);
    selectTab('link');
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { root.classList.add('pcta-loaded'); });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
